about: Cook-assist questions about the seed recipes (fixtures/evals/recipe-cards.json), asked mid-cook (TODO_MOBILE.md, D3). An answer scores by how many of `mention` it covers: each entry is a list of words or phrases, any one of which counts. `avoid` lists things a right answer doesn't say. `earlier` is the conversation before the question, when there is one.

earlier.content: How long do the garlic and ginger go for?
Just 30 seconds — toss them in the hot wok until fragrant, then return the chicken with the soy sauce and sesame oil.
